label: Present Artifact
title: Present Artifact
subtitle: Lets an agent surface produced files to the user as a chat card with Open and Preview buttons. One call can publish a single deliverable or several related artifacts together.
whenToUse: Use after producing output the user should access — a generated report, a chart, a downloaded asset, a compiled document. Bundle related artifacts (e.g. a report and its source data) in the same call so they appear together.

methods.name: Present Artifact
methods.description: Emits an artifact card with a human caption and one or more files. Each file gets an Open button (reveals in the OS file explorer on desktop, downloads in the browser) and a Preview button (in-app preview when the file type is supported — images, PDFs, and common text formats).

mediaCaption: An artifact card showing a caption above one or more file rows, each with Open and Preview buttons
